targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(event_id) AS value FROM usage_events WHERE outcome = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
SELECT uniqExact(event_id) AS value FROM usage_events WHERE outcome = 'denied' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
SELECT uniqExact(role_arn) AS value FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
SELECT uniqExact(iam_action) AS value FROM usage_events WHERE outcome = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, iam_action AS metric, uniqExact(event_id) AS value FROM usage_events WHERE outcome = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

SELECT account_id, role_arn, iam_action, uniqExactIf(event_id, outcome = 'success') AS successful_calls, uniqExactIf(event_id, outcome = 'denied') AS denied_calls, minIf(event_time, outcome = 'success') AS first_success, maxIf(event_time, outcome = 'success') AS last_success FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY account_id, role_arn, iam_action ORDER BY last_success DESC

WITH latest AS (SELECT account_id AS account_id, argMax(snapshot_id, collected_at) AS snapshot_id FROM iam_snapshots GROUP BY account_id), enrolled AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id AS account_id, role_arn AS role_arn FROM usage_events), coverage AS (SELECT min(heartbeat_time) AS first_heartbeat, max(heartbeat_time) AS last_heartbeat FROM collector_heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(heartbeat_time)), grants AS (SELECT s.account_id AS account_id, s.role_arn AS role_arn, arrayJoin(s.actions) AS action, any(s.policy_name) AS policy_name FROM iam_policy_statements AS s INNER JOIN latest AS l ON s.account_id = l.account_id AND s.snapshot_id = l.snapshot_id INNER JOIN enrolled AS e ON s.account_id = e.account_id AND s.role_arn = e.role_arn WHERE lowerUTF8(s.effect) = 'allow' AND s.origin IN ('managed', 'inline') AND position(action, '*') = 0 AND position(action, '?') = 0 AND empty(s.condition_json) GROUP BY account_id, role_arn, action), observed AS (SELECT account_id AS account_id, role_arn AS role_arn, lowerUTF8(iam_action) AS action_key, uniqExact(event_id) AS calls, max(event_time) AS last_success FROM usage_events WHERE outcome = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY account_id, role_arn, action_key) SELECT g.account_id, g.role_arn, g.action AS candidate_unused, g.policy_name, ifNull(o.calls, 0) AS observed_calls, o.last_success FROM grants AS g LEFT JOIN observed AS o ON g.account_id = o.account_id AND g.role_arn = o.role_arn AND lowerUTF8(g.action) = o.action_key CROSS JOIN coverage AS c WHERE ifNull(o.calls, 0) = 0 AND dateDiff('day', c.first_heartbeat, c.last_heartbeat) >= ${min_observation_days:raw} ORDER BY g.role_arn, candidate_unused

panels.title: Exact unobserved candidates after minimum coverage

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT account_id, argMax(snapshot_id, collected_at) AS snapshot_id FROM iam_snapshots GROUP BY account_id) SELECT s.account_id, s.role_arn, arrayJoin(s.actions) AS unresolved_pattern, s.policy_name FROM iam_policy_statements AS s INNER JOIN latest AS l ON s.account_id = l.account_id AND s.snapshot_id = l.snapshot_id WHERE lowerUTF8(s.effect) = 'allow' AND s.origin IN ('managed', 'inline') AND (position(unresolved_pattern, '*') > 0 OR position(unresolved_pattern, '?') > 0) ORDER BY s.role_arn, unresolved_pattern
